title: Mark Zuckerberg & Priscilla Chan: How AI Will Help Cure Disease

reader_summary.headline: Zuckerberg and Chan explain how AI tools will help scientists cure diseases faster.
reader_summary.overview: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan want to build new tools like virtual cell models to speed up medical research. They combine advanced AI with biological data to create specific tools for scientists. Their goal is to treat diseases by looking at each person's unique biology instead of using trial and error.

key_points.text: Virtual cell models let researchers test risky ideas on a computer first, saving time and money before doing expensive lab experiments.
key_points.evidence_quote: But if you had a virtual cell model where you could simulate really high quality biology, you could actually then start testing at tinkering on the computational side and like ask riskier questions.

key_points.text: Large language models help scientists make sense of huge amounts of biological data they had collected but could not use before.
key_points.evidence_quote: But we didn't really know what to do with them yet. And large language models coming onto the scene were like, wow, we can make sense of all of this now.

key_points.text: Success depends on scientists and AI experts working closely together to shape data and models accurately.
key_points.evidence_quote: these people need to be sort of working shoulder to shoulder and shaping each other's work for this to actually be the more and more accurate model of how the human cell works.
